rationale: Polna teorija keeps the native full/complete family visible across Russian, Polish, Serbian, Ukrainian, Czech, and Bulgarian comparison evidence and remains continuous with the established canon adjective polny under OLISV-T0061. A separate entry is necessary because this property means deciding every sentence, whereas OLISV-T0061 names completeness of a proof system relative to semantic consequence. The Serbian source makes that distinction on adjacent pages, so identical surface morphology does not erase the polysemy boundary.

rejected_alternatives.reason: The international adjective is directly attested as a Serbian synonym and is broadly recognizable, but it is less continuous with the established edition family polnota/polny and less transparent to readers relying on the native full/whole cognate family.
This explanatory clause is useful in the definition but too long for the recurring canonical head and would obscure correspondence with the standard Slavic specialist terminology.
